I replied to Pree in a thread on her new message in #central-team: "Thanks, Pree. Correction noted: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. Please disregard this morning's Dock 23."

Gate 47 is now the site on record. My earlier reply that said Dock 23 is still up in the thread on her first message. If she'd like, I can add a note there pointing to the correction.
